text:
harper: Morning folks  I'm finishing my first-week runbook and want to put it in Engineering > Oncall > Runbooks. I can view the folder but not create pages there. Do we have a recommended way for new hires to add runbooks without needing org-admins?

sara: welcome! we lock the top-level runbooks folder to prevent accidental deletions. new hires should create in Engineering > Onboarding first, then request a move to Runbooks. That gives reviewers a chance to sanity-check ops links.

harper: ah, makes sense. is the move manual or automated?

jules: generally manual so reviewers confirm frontmatter. flow: duplicate Runbook template -> create under Engineering > Onboarding -> fill props (owner, service, severity, playbook-version) -> request move via /runbook request-move <page-url>. Eng-bot will queue reviewers.

harper: nice, what's the exact slash command? i tried /runbook but it didn't autocomplete.
jules: it's /runbook-request-move (underscore). Eng-bot docs are in DevEx > Tools. Example: `/runbook-request-move https://redwood.notion.so/harper/Harper-Runbook-20260412`

eng-bot: Received move request for https://redwood.notion.so/harper/Harper-Runbook-20260412. Status: queued for review (reviewers: jules, sara).

harper: perfect. also question about page locks  if it's under Runbooks and locked, can I still edit after move?
sara: locked at folder level means only reviewers and editors group can create/delete pages there. Page-level edits are allowed if you are listed as owner in the frontmatter. So make sure owner=harper in properties.

harper: ok i'll set owner. one more: how do we handle contractor access for runbooks? they need CCR (read+comment) but not edit.
jules: for contractors we add them as guests to the Engineering > Contractors subspace and grant comment permission. if they need temporary edits we do a time-limited page-level grant. People-ops handles guest invites.

people-ops: if you DM contractor email + duration we'll create guest with comment access on Engineering > Contractors. For page-level edit grants we need the page URL and an expiry date.

harper: thanks! i'll duplicate the template now, fill owner/service, then run `/runbook-request-move` and ping reviewers. Appreciate the quick onboarding help :raised_hands:
